name: Asset-harvesting contract 0x19a2 unauthorised payer transferFrom
summary: The shared asset-harvesting contract 0x19a2, which BSC MEV bots approve, lets anyone register an order with themselves as executor (0xac3994ec) and then executes token.transferFrom(payer, recipient, amount) with payer and amount taken from calldata (0x1270d364). The attacker drained bot 0x8c2d's full BUSDT allowance; copycats drained other approvers.
notes: The defect and the age target is the approved contract 0x19a2, not the bot; the bot's approval is an allowance and does not reset the contract's code age. Earlier 0x19a2 executions are its deployer's own orders.
Campaign is every 0x19a2 order event (0x0ff585d6) whose executor is not the deployer's: two copycat drains of other approvers by 0xb7025bd9 and one by 0x89852785.
